prompts.prompt: We want a separate area in Human for our field service work — the visits, the engineers who do them, and the equipment they service — and a dashboard showing visits per engineer this month and what is still waiting on a follow-up.
In our Human contacts_crm namespace I want to start logging the calls we make to contacts, and a dashboard of how the calling is going — how many per outcome, and who we have not called in a while.
